items.prompt: A backtest assumes any historical touch of a limit price fills the entire order. What evidence or assumptions are missing?
items.modelAnswer: Queue/arrival/latency, visible versus hidden depth, size and allocation rules, cancellations/competing flow, feed coverage/timing and eligible order attributes. Full fill on touch can be optimistic and needs an explicit model rather than a price-only claim.

criteria.text: Labels assumptions and possible fill bias.
